proposal.utterance: Classify 'agent connectedness' as a kind of entity.

entities.label: AgentConnectedness
entities.rationale: Agent connectedness denotes a relational property that inheres in an agent (or a set of agents) — the degree or character of being connected to other agents. This is best modeled as a Quality (BFO_0000019): a specifically dependent continuant that inheres in its bearer(s) and is measurable/characterizable. It is not a Role (externally conferred social function), not a Disposition (internally grounded capacity), and not a Process (it persists rather than unfolds). It is a common noun denoting a kind, so it is a class.

relations.rationale: AgentConnectedness is a subclass of Quality (BFO_0000019), as it is a specifically dependent continuant characterizing the relational state of an agent with respect to other agents.

open_questions: Is 'agent connectedness' intended to characterize a single agent (a quality inhering in one bearer) or a collective of agents (a relational quality inhering in a group or network)? This affects whether the bearer is an individual material entity or an aggregate.

Should 'agent connectedness' be typed instead as a Disposition (BFO_0000016) — e.g., a capacity or tendency to form connections — rather than a Quality? If the intent is a stable propensity rather than a current measurable state, Disposition would be more appropriate.
Is this concept intended to relate to the existing working:RelationalCoherence or working:RelationalDependencyNetwork classes, or is it intended as a distinct primitive?
proposal.rationale_summary: The phrase 'agent connectedness' most naturally denotes a relational property characterizing how an agent (or agents) stands in connection to others — a Quality (BFO_0000019) that inheres in its bearer(s) and persists through time. I mint it as a new class working:AgentConnectedness, typed as a subclass of BFO_0000019 Quality. The main uncertainty is whether the intended meaning is a current-state quality vs. a dispositional capacity (which would favor BFO_0000016 Disposition), and whether the bearer is singular or collective. These are flagged as open questions. No existing working class precisely covers this concept, though working:RelationalCoherence is adjacent and the user may wish to relate the two.
